text.title: Outcome Based Roadmaps Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example for Outcome Based Roadmaps: trigger fires, inputs gathered, artefact produced and validated against output contract.

example.title: Happy-path application
example.trigger: Operator opens calendar slot named in Applies If; preconditions are met.
example.validation: Run scripts/validate-outcome-based-roadmaps.py against the produced artefact. Expected exit 0 (ok).
example.downstream: Artefact handed off to the consumers named in Related; outcome reviewed at next iteration.

example.title: Solo SaaS churn quarter — concrete values
example.trigger: Q2 planning slot; one instrumented outcome worth pursuing; churn dashboard already live.
example.inputs: Outcome 'Reduce churn from 8% to 5% by EOQ2' (verb+metric+delta+timeframe per r6); baseline 8% read from the churn dashboard and its URL recorded per r8; kill signal 'churn > 9% by week 6' per r7.
example.validation: Trace r1-outcomes-first → r6-verb-metric-delta-timeframe → r8-tie-to-dashboard → r7-kill-signal → r2-three-outcomes-max → r4-confidence-per-solution. Validator exit 0.
example.downstream: Each solution is tagged with its outcome id, so the delivery backlog stays joined to the roadmap (fm-07); the not-doing list answers the stakeholder question the roadmap otherwise leaves open.

example.title: Un-anchored application
example.trigger: Operator skipped Applies If gate; preconditions not verified.
example.inputs: Free-text prose substitutes; no cited evidence.
example.validation: Validator returns non-zero with violation list per forbidden patterns in content/02-output-contract.xml.
example.downstream: Artefact rejected; consumers do not read; operator reruns with full preconditions.
